The structure of Ca8Mg4Fe4O20 (reduced formula Ca2MgFeO5) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 36 atoms per unit cell across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Ca, Fe, and Mg centers, each coordinated by six O neighbors, while O centers have four geometric neighbors (two Ca, one Fe, one Mg). The octahedra display corner- and edge-sharing contacts among Ca, Fe, and Mg centers, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 36 sites.
